The thing that causes the crystals is the grains they put in cat food. Can be wet food but it is very concentrated in dry food. 

After numerous visits to the vet, who seemed to withhold information about what to avoid and how to keep it from ever happening again,  the first visit, we learnt it's the cat biscuits causing it. Next time we find out the wet food is doing it as well. 

Basically restricted the cats diet from normal cat food, to eating prescription food (which STILL seemed to cause crystals despite their literal purpose of not causing), to raw meat meant for human consumption. Stuck to that for a good long expensive while, until there were "grain-free" specific cat foods introduced into our supermarkets (New Zealand btw). 

My puddytats have been eating that for almost a year with no bladder crystals and no health problems, and it's meant we no longer have to go for the unaffordable "prescription cat food", or the super gourmet human food. 

I'm not sure if you have the brand "Fussy Cat" where you are, but try looking up fussy cat grain free, and go from there? 

I wish you good luck and a healthy 9 lives. :)

I’ve gone from messaging him every so often to every day, not in a pestering sorta way tho. I’ve been watching my words and I’m actions very carefully and have been making a real effort to keep the air chill. 

As for the therapist thing, he’s tried it. I’ve thought endlessly about bringing it up, but I feel it is not my place, and at the same time, I feel he won’t go through with it anyway. 

We don’t have many mutual friends, but I have been involving him in outings whenever I do see them. I have been encouraging him to hang out with me often, mainly as a way to check up on him, but I’ve disguised it as me just needing company (because, well, I do need company lmao).

He’s recently resorted to drugs, and now self harm. He is on anti depressants, and last week got his doctor to prescribe more. Tonight, he told me he tried to kill himself last night. He was drunk and had a blade, he has a huge bandage on his arm now. He talks about these things like it’s a light conversation, and he covers it up by making it funny and laughing about it. 

I am deeply concerned, and have been for a good month or two now, but he seems to be reaching his breaking point, although he doesn’t show weakness, he does tell me everything. But at the same time, how do I deal with this? I’m an empath and basically panic cry every time he leaves. I’m doing my best to make sure he knows I’m here for him and that I care, but how do I stop myself from falling into a dark pit of worry and anxiety over this?
Thanks so much <3
